玩了2天，开了20倍速挂的，目前无尽34层，挂不动了。对面数值每层增加提升的都十分离谱，开局拿不到优势就会立马被对面一波带走。属性全靠反复倒腾装备词条，强化和那沟槽的符文来提升。不搞装备纯建筑和英雄都满级撑死只能推到无尽10层左右。本人装备全+10，属性和倒腾融了下才磕磕碰碰到34，还经常对面开局一波直接把我送走，只能随机到对面哥布林史莱姆这种比较弱势的阵营才能苟赢，刷到深渊元素这种开局直接没了，作为挂机游戏前中期确实挂机，只靠英雄和建筑提升就能挂，符合挂机本质。从倒腾词条开始就变成肝的游戏了，几十上百件装备一件件看过去挑词条再融合，装备还有潜力融3.4次就不能融了，融过的还不能当素材给其他装备融，玩的心累，缝的这个偏离挂机的初衷本末倒置了。唯一优点就是这逼游戏只花了20块。

i wish there was a star system to rate the game. by no means is this a permanent negative review. i think this lays at a 3/5 in terms of early access. 1) i think i would've preferred if the loot was equipping the units themselves. like each individual building has its own set of armor and stuff to put onto it. 2) this plays into #1, items that affect the units in more ways like "slimes troops can do this, humans gain this, goblins gain this" 3) relics are awful design wise what's the point of a rarity system if i just get them all in 3 runs. the finite amount of uses subtract from the fun of having a briefcase full of gold coins for 1000% gold increase. 4) the actual gameplay is truly idle, there is little to nothing we get to do as a player. instead of enjoying the game i payed for i just put this on in the background while i play songs of syx. 5)level desgin felt great if it was a tutorial, but my jaw dropped when that was the full game.

A Addictive Auto-Battler Masterpiece: Big Armies, Deep Strategy, and Pure Fun If you love the satisfying progression of idle games blended with the strategic depth of an auto-battler, this game is an absolute hidden gem. It starts deceptively simple but quickly grows into an incredibly deep, chaotic, and rewarding experience. The Gameplay Loop: From Humble Beginnings to Massive Armies You start the game with just a single building slot—for example, a Barracks. Every 20.2 seconds (which is already upgraded from the base speed, thanks to a 60% cooldown reduction!), a unit spawns automatically. They march straight toward the enemy lines, and the battle begins. As your units defeat enemies, you earn Gold, Materials, Runes, and Equipment. You use that hard-earned Gold to unlock up to 10 different building slots. The beauty of the game lies in the total freedom it gives you. Want to build 10 Mage Academies and watch the world burn? You can! However, marching into battle without a frontline Tank might not end well. Success relies on finding the perfect synergy between Tanks, Healers, and Damage Dealers (DD). Deep Customization and Build Variety What truly elevates the game is how equipment and upgrades work: Global Loot: Items you equip don't just buff one character—they apply to ALL of your units. If you find gear that stacks Lightning Damage, you can pivot your entire strategy toward Mages and watch their chain-lightning melt enemy waves. Building Upgrades: Gold can be reinvested into each individual building to permanently boost your units' stats, including Damage, HP, HP Regeneration, Armor, Movement Speed, and Production Speed. Relics: Later in the game, you unlock powerful Relics that offer game-changing passive bonuses (like the Broken Crown, which boosts your Gold gain by 30%). Passive Heroes: You also level up various Heroes. While they don't fight on the battlefield themselves, their talent trees provide massive, global buffs to your entire army every time they level up. The Endgame: Endless Progression Once you conquer the main stages, the real challenge begins. The endgame features an Endless Mode where you push as high as your build allows. The higher you climb, the better the loot drops, constantly pushing you to optimization and min-maxing your army setup. The Verdict All in all, this game is incredibly fun. Watching the bustling, chaotic battle animations as your custom-built army swarms the screen and marches toward victory is immensely satisfying. If you enjoy watching numbers go up, tweaking builds, and managing a growing army, this is a must-play. My Rating: 9/10 — Highly Addictive! German: Man startet erst mit Platz für 1 Gebäude. z.b. Barracks. Dort werden bei mir alle 20,2 Sekunden (eigentlich 60% langsamer, habe schon Upgrades) eine Einheit erschafft. Diese rennt dann automatisch dem Feind entgegen und kämpft für dich. Für jeden Gegner verdienst du Gold , später Materialien/Runen, und Gegenstände. Diese Gegenstände kannst du equipen, sie zählen für ALLE deine Einheiten. Man kann sich z.b. spezialisieren und viel + Lightning Dmg equipen und größtenteils auf Magier gehen, um mit ihrem Kettenblitz alles zu rösten. Mit dem verdienten Gold kann ich dann neue Gebäude Slots freischalten. Zum Schluss können es 10 verschiedene Gebäude sein, und ich kann selbst bestimmten welche. z.b. 10x Magier Akademie (muss aber nicht sinnvoll sein ohne Tank in den Kampf zu ziehen) Der Mix macht es. Healer, Tanks, DD. Je nachdem. was für Items man auch findet. Zusätzlich kann ich mit dem Gold in jedem Gebäude Upgrades kaufen, und die produzierte Einheit dort verbessern. + Schaden, HP, HP-Regeneration, Armor, Movementspeed, Produktionsgeschwindigkeit. Später findet man noch Relikte, die besondere Eigenschaften haben. Diese kann man zusätzlich zu den Gegenständen extra auswählen. (z.b. "Broken Crown" , bringt mit 30% mehr Gold) Zusätzlich Levelt man verschiedene Helden, die zwar nicht aktiv mitkämpfen, aber durch ihren Talentbaum bei jedem Level, alle unsere Einheiten besser machen. Endgame ist ein Endlos Modus, in den man immer weiter nach oben klettert. Je höher, je besser die Drops. Alles in Allem macht es Spaß immer besser zu werden, und die wuseligen Kampfanimationen anzuschauen, wie meine Armee meistens zum Sieg geführt wird. Meine Bewertung: 9/10

[h1]独特的自动化游戏——《放置:纸色新境》[/h1] 和以往挂机放置类游戏不同，《放置:纸色新境》给玩家带来一种前所未有的独特体验。 游戏中，玩家需要在有限的格子上设置相关建筑，类似兵营、骑士大厅、黏黏树等一系列建筑。 通过自动产生士兵，来与不同boss进行对抗。 有趣的是，随着玩家击败boss，通过不同关卡。 系统会陆续解锁天赋、遗物、新建筑等物品，让游戏体验更进一步。 游戏的核心，实际上是通过不断的对抗、死亡及复活，来获得大量金币。 再通过金币来升级相关建筑，让你的队伍愈发强大。 另一方面，多回合的对战，让玩家的等级不断提升，这也是取得胜利的关键点。 虽说游戏中存在不同属性的装备，但是装备的加成在我看来很是微弱。 而游戏中的遗物反而恰到好处，类似于背包管理的玩法，让玩家轻松装备各类强大神器，带来质的飞跃。 而天赋系统往往和玩家的血量、攻击等方面挂钩，玩家所获得的天赋点数，一方面用于大项的激活，当你点亮10点时，才可以激活小项。 另一方面，每一小项的加成，带来的也不容小觑，提高7%的生命回复，或是3%的生产效率，都能为战场带来不错的提升。 整体体验下来，《放置:纸色新境》作为一款以挂机玩法为核心的放置刷装备游戏，装备,遗物,天赋, 单位协同,超级首领,无尽模式等内容, 玩起来轻松休闲，还算不错！ [quote]欢迎关注我们的鉴赏家:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402982/]走心评测[/url] ←遵从内心，写出真实感受 欢迎加入我们Steam组:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ZXPC]走心评测[/url]←点击加入，一起探索游戏的乐趣 喜欢这篇评论，也麻烦点个赞，让更多人能够看到！[/quote]

Its a good game at the start but as it goes on you realize you have nothing to do but wait for long periods, I know its idle but most Idles have something the player can do while the grind happens. Also while it looks deep the systems feel pretty bare to be honest, Level up buildings with gold, yourself with talent points and finally equip gear and relics, that it. Your supposed to be able to level up gear, I haven't figured that one out yet as salvaging gives nothing tangible. It needs more systems, more things to do or that you can do. I personally recommend the following: -A blacksmith for gear creation and refinement. -A quest system with rewards. -A hero unit that actually fights, with their own levels and skills. -A Magic skill system so you can cast skills to help in combat with levels and mana costs (tie it to main hero theme and level). -A secondary equipment system, to augment gear (I.E. Gems slots or Reroll-able Affixes) If gems, add a merging and leveling system as well to further increase the systems viability. Maybe add a separate "gem grid" with slots to augment the build instead of adding to equipment itself. -Unit Levels, outside of gold levels, the more a type of unit is used the stronger it gets. could be a simple +1% dmg and health per level. -Some kind of Home base that can be invested into with bonus for doing so. Such as an Inn for regen increase, a merchant for gold gain etc.
pretty good for what it is. hope the developer keeps adding to the game.
